name: Apothecary Zinge
summary: Beneath the ruins of Lordaeron, Apothecary Zinge studies specimens for the Forsaken. Her work also sends research shipments across Horde lands.

sections.title: In Service to the Society
sections.body: In the Apothecarium beneath the Undercity, Apothecary Zinge serves the Forsaken. She works under Master Apothecary Faranell, searching for chemical and biological compounds that can advance their aims. Her research links her to field researchers and scouts far beyond Tirisfal Glades, even at distant outposts in Kalimdor.

sections.title: Cross-Continental Experiments
sections.body: Apothecary Zinge relies on couriers and adventurers to carry test materials across the sea. She regularly writes to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Her shipments include toxic wolf heart samples from Silverpine Forest, so he can study how Lordaeron's toxins affect Kalimdor's beasts.

faq.q: Where can Apothecary Zinge be found?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zinge works in the Apothecarium, the alchemical quarter on the Undercity's southeastern tier.

faq.q: What organization does she belong to?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zinge belongs to the Royal Apothecary Society. Its Forsaken alchemists create concoctions, plagues, and antidotes in service to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: Why does she need samples from the Barrens?
faq.answer: The samples travel from Silverpine Forest to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads. Zinge has adventurers carry toxic wolf hearts to her colleague, who studies how Lordaeron's toxins affect Kalimdor's beasts.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you can see researchers like Zinge advancing your people's scientific independence. They work tirelessly on solutions meant to secure the Forsaken's survival and supremacy.
As Horde, you rely on open supply routes and trusted runners crossing the sea between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. These routes keep your front lines supplied.
